items.text: Saquon Barkley is active for MNF vs Cowboys; ETR had him EXPECTED TO PLAY.
Puka Nacua listed GTD/OPTIMISM in weekend injury summary; later confirmed ACTIVE vs Raiders after calf issue with optimism he would play absent setbacks.
items.why: Calf; felt better Saturday, sources optimistic if no setbacks.
items.implication: Full WR1 role intact for Rams offense.

items.text: Breece Hall GTD/PESSIMISM in summary; confirmed INACTIVE vs Dolphins after quad strain, missing fourth straight game.
items.why: Quad; limited practice, unlikely per sources, no full participation.

items.text: Jonah Coleman LOVE/upgrade: first game back led Broncos backfield 50% snaps, 41% rush, 34% routes; Dobbins 21% snaps, Harvey fluky TD.
Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value-touch thesis: worst runner (dead last 3.1 YPC, poor EPA/RYOE) yet fantasy RB13 PPG via 9 inside-5 carries + league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.implication: Sustainable fantasy RB2/flex despite poor rushing.
items.opportunity: Elite RZ + target share in LV scheme.
items.conflict: Efficiency data poor vs fantasy output.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs almost certainly fine after ankle turn on purposeful slide; would have been tilting if serious while correctly not scoring.
items.implication: No expected miss or role change for DET RB1.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT in weekend summary; missed third straight with ankle/high-ankle sprain.
items.implication: Backup QB start; Ravens pass game downgrade.
items.opportunity: Huntley or equivalent elevated; Andrews/Likely volume may shift.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT; impacts Eagles WR depth for MNF.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining WRs/TEs like Goedert or rookies.

items.text: Josh Jacobs listed IN for Packers return.
Put some respect on Tee Higgins’ name after strong showing.
Tony Pollard EXPLODED Sunday; sell-high opportunity if possible in fantasy.
Texans WR routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24 lead; Tank Dell only 6 in first game since 2024 (limited return); Noel 15 left early turf toe.
items.why: Post-Dell return limited; Collins dominates routes.
items.implication: Nico clear alpha; Dell ramp slow.
items.opportunity: Nico high target share; Dell handcuff stash if ramps.

items.text: Xavier Worthy 33 routes on 36 Mahomes dropbacks (2nd game w/o Rice); has never topped 83 rec yds in 37 games despite high volume.
items.implication: High floor volume but historical ceiling cap.

items.text: Cam Skattebo actually hurt (hamstring) but not certain; listed on ETR watch after purposeful slide attempt.
items.implication: Monitor for NYG backfield; possible reduced role.
items.opportunity: If out, Tracy or others expand.
